{{Top|leg}}
'''Hugard''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Hugard replied to [[Bolton]]'s comment on the [[DC5-1]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] about [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] officials tending to believe the internal cargo manifest. Hugard agreed that the reprogamming the droid was easy, but smart Customs officials would check the hardwired backup module.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
